title: A bracketed group with individual barlines
description: Two violin parts in one bracketed group whose barlineStyle is individual: each staff closes its own barline instead of sharing one stroke through the group — the convention for vocal groups, here exercised on the smallest possible pair. individual is the one member of the enum the renderer distinguishes; instrument, unified and mensurstrich all currently draw as the unified default, which is why this scenario pins the honored value rather than the whole enum.
